notes.title: Mutiny update + Steam Summer Sale
notes.content:
We decided to make an update based on recent events, in which you will be able to switch the game mode, in mutiny mode, in which the piglet and military commissar will be replaced by all known characters that will run away from each other! To do this you need to click on the button PMC Wagner in the main menu of the game, after which it will be highlighted in green, if you click on it again everything will return to normal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43633365/babef60f7307b16605b13ce1a1986e228ca6ff28.gif[/img]
In honor of this update and the Steam summer sale, we're launching a two-week, maximum 72% discount, don't miss your chance to experience the newest story yourself through a fun gaming experience or send the game to your friends as a gift, let them be ready for anything! 

Don't forget to sign up for our curated group:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/GosDev
And the developer's group:
https://steamcommunity.com/groups/GosDev
Feel free to email GosDevProduction@gmail.com with any questions or suggestions.

notes.title: Customization and Steam Inventory
notes.content:
We are happy to announce [b]customization system[/b] using Steam Inventory Service! During the game, you will drop chests that you can [b]open[/b], [b]transfer[/b] to other users, or [b]sell[/b] on the Steam Community Market. There are 3 types of chests in total:
[h3]Chest with Hats:[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43633365/992dfa34d1fa639c562ff9b6580b28b5da021268.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43633365/5c80101eafa659d8cecb03e778bb27adda0badab.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Chest with clothes:[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43633365/006e70f21b4075ca043a5c51908eba0ffb9befd0.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43633365/7c2ecdce4536a4f4e5c324b0c8e6018b593ac7f2.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Presidential Chest, which has the highest rarity and most valuable items:[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43633365/d48d86bea3f2d9f81ffe9b26370329460864c1f5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43633365/f2260136b191acff42785576e61aadbffa3578a6.png[/img][/url]
[h3]Thanks to items from chests, you can create bright and unique character's appearance, here are a few examples:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43633365/ca021a2bebad5c79471abe6b984a888548fe39c7.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43633365/2b0a7c51e297a57a2acdf6e9216bb04ab53da75b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43633365/d2e211ca8a709a513f95df2520cf2b1fe3de1532.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43633365/4d9c0fdbbd68d923216ff2e35a4cfab7eb1b02d9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43633365/8f52b3a86c3a54df64a1d100143b8a18aa58a843.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43633365/c7d855632414f49b701f4d5b3e2f260460c46533.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43633365/c7eca809891cd8263ffe658b8bc29e3fe8ef3b46.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43633365/da2f42c8db52efd25f54a75ea24b45146870f5a4.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43633365/0c4dece2ea4cdb87cf9796d612c6d5d5516ee8d7.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43633365/a2841a234ffe8197aa697573c3eb01964162779e.png[/img]

All customization items are also tradable and marketable, so you can always sell extra items and [b]earn extra money[/b] or buy the ones you like :)

If you like the game and the clothes feel free to [b]add the game to your wishlist[/b], [b]follow to updates[/b] and [b]advise it to your friends[/b]!

You can also subscribe to our group:
https://steamcommunity.com/groups/GosDev

And to our curatorial group:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/GosDev

Closer to the release, we will giveaway keys and customization items there!
With all questions and suggestions feel free to write to GosDevProduction@gmail.com
